messages:
maya: Quick ping — opened a small PR to fix two things in the Python quickstart examples and add a smoke test for the streaming snippet. Need one approval + merge before tomorrow's docs build cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/642 :link:

alex: :eyes: dropping by to review now, can you note which CI check is flaky so I can focus? thanks

maya: CI flaky is the lint job that trips on an import reorder and a line-length in examples/streaming.py. Smoke test fails locally if you run with an older SDK installed. I added a note in the PR about pinning to >=0.7.2 for the test run.

sam: I can take a pass in ~30m. ping me if you want me to run the smoke locally. I have the infra to run end-to-end quickstart steps.

jordan: small nit in the docs: the JS sample still references `RedwoodClient` in one spot — should be `redwood`. I added an inline suggestion. other than that LGTM.

maya: thanks — I pushed a tiny commit addressing the JS var and reordered imports per lint. CI kicked off again.

ci-bot: build/ci-lint failed — line-length in examples/streaming.py:78

maya: fixing that now, will keep it within 100 chars.

sam: ran the smoke test against the updated branch, streaming sample passes with SDK 0.7.3. tested on mac and ubuntu-latest. :white_check_mark:

alex: reviewed and left an approval. also added a tiny wording suggestion for clarity but not blocking.

maya: great — thanks all. merging once the final lint run succeeds. if anyone needs to back this out after the docs deploy ping me.

ci-bot: build/ci-lint succeeded

maya: merged and pushed. :shipit: will follow up if anything pops in staging.
